content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Status: deviation (critical)** — Section 20 contains only a one-way Customer indemnity for "every claim relating in any way to Customer's use of the Services," with no Vendor indemnity anywhere in the Agreement, and Section 9.3's reliance on "the remedies required by Section 20.5" is a dangling cross-reference. That is walk-away territory under INDEMN, so the fallback is not met.

**Redline (validated ok:true):** rewrote 20.1 as the preferred Vendor defence/indemnity (IP infringement, breach of Applicable Law, Vendor-caused Customer Data incidents, gross negligence/wilful misconduct), and inserted 20.2–20.5 covering a narrowed Customer indemnity (Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law), standard notice/control/cooperation procedure, the customary modification/combination/specification exclusions, and procure-modify-replace-refund remedies that also cure the Section 9.3 cross-reference.
